name: usage-band
description: Your Claude plan usage in one line above the prompt: 5-hour and weekly limits with reset times, context window, model and session cost.

weekly_reset.title: Weekly limit reset time (optional)
weekly_reset.description: When your weekly limit resets, in your local time, e.g. "Sat 14:30" or "Saturday 2:30 PM" (see Claude Settings > Usage). Leave empty to detect it automatically.

alerts.title: Limit alerts
alerts.description: Show a pop-up when the 5-hour or weekly limit reaches 80% and 95%, and when it resets.

pace.title: Pace warning
pace.description: Show ⚠ next to a limit you are using faster than its window is passing.

compact_button.title: Compact button
compact_button.description: Show a Compact button in the band once the context window is over 70% full.

reply_cost.title: Last reply cost
reply_cost.description: Show what the last reply cost next to the session cost, e.g. $13.24 (+$0.41).

tooltips.title: Tooltips
tooltips.description: In the desktop app, show details when you hover over a ring.
